title: Tech Note: Open Data File
featured_technology: Programmatic data file selection and relaunch

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates letting end users switch among multiple 4D data files sharing one structure file (.4DB) — a classic Design Mode-era pattern from before Project Mode existed. The core idea of supporting multiple data sets against a shared application definition is still conceptually relevant, but the mechanics described (structure file relaunch, manual data-file selection dialogs) are specific to the old binary structure-file architecture and predate today's project-based, more flexible data-connection approaches.
related_updates: 4D's Project Mode (introduced v17, 2018) decouples the app definition from a single binary structure file, changing how multi-data-file scenarios are typically implemented
Modern 4D applications more commonly use separate hosted/remote data sources or ORDA data models rather than manually relaunching with a different local data file
